> 第十五章 失望绝望（第1页）
：失望，绝望！观玄殿内。叶天命盘坐在地，他双手叠放在自己腿上，他默默运行着《天命决》，《天命决》刚刚创造，还有许多不完善的地方，他现在要做的就是完善这天命决。因为按照他现在估算，上部《天命决》最多只能让他达到大劫境，想要继续提升，就必须完善《天命决》。而他现在最为苦恼的就是，他没有见过别的高级修行功法，根本没有借鉴的地方。原本想着来到观玄书院后，可以见识一下别的修行功法，但却没有想到出了这些事情。小塔并没有打扰叶天命，对于叶天命创造功法这一事，它自然是支持的，如果这个小家伙真的创造出一步无敌功法，那功劳是谁的？自然是它塔爷的至少有一半是它的。如果这家伙把天命决这个名字改成：天命小塔决那就更完美了。想到这，它顿时热血沸腾。当然，它意识到，要让这个家伙心甘情愿改名字，它自然是得出点力的，于是，它开始在关键时刻指点这个小家伙。当小塔帮忙改善功法的一处细节后，叶天命顿时大为震惊，“塔祖，您对修行一道竟然如此精通。”小塔哈哈一笑，“我跟你一样，虽然实力很弱很弱，但书读得多，所以，对修行一道，略通一二。”叶天命道：“塔祖，我们一起创造这功法，以后若是成功，就以你我之名一起命名，就叫《天命塔祖决》，好不好？”小塔心里乐开了花，直呼这小子上道，但嘴上却道：“小家伙，你塔祖我淡泊名利的很，这些虚名什么的，从来都不在意当然，你如果非要这么命名，那塔祖也不拦你。”叶天命对于这塔祖的性格，多少有了一些了解，很显然，这位塔祖比较好面子，看来，自己以后要多拍拍它马屁才行。就这样，在塔祖的帮忙指点下，他这功法的进度顿时飞速提升。到了傍晚，那周擎突然走了进来，他看着叶天命，“叶公子，书院副院主袁起想与你谈谈，你看”叶天命道：“我可以不跟他聊吗？”周擎道：“他说他是带着诚意来的。”叶天命深深看了一眼周擎，“那就让他进来吧。”周擎点头，“好。”很快，袁起走了进来。周擎并未离去，有了上次的事情后，他是真怕了，万一这小家伙真的想不开，那事情就真的不可收拾了。大长老走到叶天命面前，微笑道：“叶公子，我是学院副院主袁起，你可以叫我袁长老。”叶天命看着他，不说话。袁起道：“叶公子，你知道他们为何派我来吗？”叶天命摇头，“不知道。”袁起笑道：“因为我没有参与这个特招名额的事情，就算青州自查，只要你不死在这里，我也不会有任何的影响。”叶天命道：“袁长老是想告诉我，你对我问心无愧，或者说，你完全是公立的？”袁起笑道：“你比我想象的还要聪明，我也坦白与你说，我这次代表的不是书院，而是萧家。”叶天命道：“看来，书院是不会打算严惩那些涉事的长老与萧家了。”袁起转头看向周擎，周擎道：“袁长老放心，这里不会有任何人监听。”他刚刚已经暗暗用神识查过叶天命身上的纳戒，纳戒内并没有记录仪。叶天命再次看了一眼周擎，很显然，这位青州观玄卫统领是他们的人。袁了点头，道：“叶公子，我就直接开门见山了。因为这次涉事的长老很多，因此，书院是绝不可能自查的，若是自查，整个青州书院立即就会大乱，因为牵扯的人会很多很多，也会影响院主与各大院的主事人的前途，所以，即使没有萧家，书院这边也不会站在你这边，这就是事实。”叶天命沉默。见到叶天命没有太激烈的反应，袁起继续道：“即使退一万步来说，书院真的站在你这边，也不太可能动得了萧家，！！谢谢大家的支持！

The latest chapter of Invincible Destiny_Chapter 15 Disappointment and Despair Page 1_On the Qingluan Peak of Invincible Destiny_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Disappointment and Despair (Page 1)
: Disappointment, despair! Inside Guanxuan Hall. Ye Tianming sat cross-legged on the ground, with his hands folded on his legs. He silently ran the "Destiny Jue". "Destiny Jue" had just been created, and there were still many imperfections. What he had to do now was to perfect this Destiny Jue. Because according to his current estimation, the upper part of "Destiny Jue" can only allow him to reach the Great Tribulation Realm at best. If he wants to continue to improve, he must perfect "Destiny Jue". What troubles him the most now is that he has never seen any other advanced cultivation techniques and has nothing to learn from. I originally thought that after coming to Guanxuan Academy, I could experience other cultivation techniques, but I didn't expect these things to happen. Xiaota did not disturb Ye Tianming. It naturally supported Ye Tianming's creation of the technique. If this little guy really created a one-step invincible technique, who gets the credit? Naturally, at least half of the tower belongs to it. It would be even more perfect if this guy changed the name Tianmingjue to: Tianming Xiaotajue. Thinking of this, his blood suddenly boiled. Of course, it realized that it would have to do something to make this guy willing to change his name, so it began to give pointers to this little guy at critical moments. When Xiaota helped improve a detail of the practice, Ye Tianming was immediately shocked. "Tazu, you are so proficient in the practice." Xiaota laughed, "I am like you. Although I am very weak, I have read a lot of books, so I know a thing or two about the practice." Ye Tianming said: "Tazu, let's create this technique together. If it succeeds in the future, we will name it after you and me. It will be called "Destiny Tazu Jue" ", okay?" Xiaota was happy in his heart and called the boy up, but he said: "Little guy, you Tazu, I am very indifferent to fame and wealth. Of course, if you insist on naming it like this, Tazu will not stop you." Ye Tianming has some understanding of this Tazu's character. It is obvious that this Tazu is more face-saving. It seems that he will have to flatter him more in the future. In this way, with Tazu's help and guidance, the progress of his technique suddenly improved rapidly. In the evening, Zhou Qing suddenly walked in. He looked at Ye Tianming, "Master Ye, Yuan Qi, the deputy dean of the academy, wants to talk to you. Look," Ye Tianming said, "Can I not talk to him?" Zhou Qing said, "He said he came with sincerity." Ye Tianming took a deep look at Zhou Qing and said, "Then let him in." Zhou Qing nodded, "Okay." Soon, Yuan Qi walked in. Zhou Qing didn't leave. After what happened last time, he was really scared. If this little guy really couldn't think about it, then things would really get out of hand. The great elder walked up to Ye Tianming and said with a smile: "Master Ye, I am Yuan Qi, the deputy dean of the college. You can call me Elder Yuan." Ye Tianming looked at him and said nothing. Yuan Qidao: "Young Master Ye, do you know why they sent me here?" Ye Tianming shook his head, "I don't know." Yuan Qi smiled and said: "Because I was not involved in this special recruitment quota matter, even if Qingzhou self-examination, as long as you don't die here, I will not have any impact." Ye Tianming said: "Elder Yuan wants to tell me that you have a clear conscience towards me, or that you are completely public?" Yuan Qi smiled and said: "You You are smarter than I thought, and I will tell you frankly that I am not representing the academy this time, but the Xiao family." Ye Tianming said: "It seems that the academy will not severely punish the elders and Xiao family involved." Yuan Qi turned to look at Zhou Qing, and Zhou Qing said: "Elder Yuan, don't worry, there will be no one listening here." He had just used his spiritual consciousness to check the Na ring on Ye Tianming, and there was no recorder in the Na ring. Ye Tianming glanced at Zhou Qing again,It was obvious that the Qingzhou Guanxuan Guard Commander was one of theirs. Yuan nodded and said: "Mr. Ye, I'll get straight to the point. Because there are many elders involved this time, it is absolutely impossible for the academy to conduct a self-examination. If there is a self-examination, the entire Qingzhou Academy will immediately be in chaos, because there will be many people involved, and it will also affect the future of the academy owner and the principals of each academy. Therefore, even if there is no Xiao family, the academy will not stand on your side. This is a fact." Ye Tianming was silent. Seeing that Ye Tianming didn't react too fiercely, Yuan Qi continued: "Even if you take 10,000 steps back and the academy is really on your side, it is unlikely that you can touch the Xiao family!! Thank you for your support!
